input.command: tools list; tools list calendar --schema; tools list mail --schema; tools list drive --schema

tools call mail.draft --json - <<'JSON'
{"reply_to":"msg_79ff6bd2088143e5","to":["dana@example.test"],"subject":"Re: Q3 budget numbers","body":"Hi Dana,

I'll bring the [Q3 Budget spreadsheet](https://docs.example.test/spreadsheets/d/f-budget) to the planning review so we can go over the Q3 travel line.

Sam"}
JSON
